item.title: A Realistic Look at Renovating an Old Carbureted Dodge Van
item.description: If you came here for a finished van with a solar array on the roof and a fridge humming in the corner, this isn’t that post. This is the honest middle: a 1987 Dodge B350 that’s mostly gutted, a coolant leak I chased with my own pant leg, and a freeze plug I managed to start backwards. Most of what follows is planning and research, not installs — because on an old carbureted RV, getting the plan right is most of the work, and I’ve already learned a couple of things the hard way.
